notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_220925
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update with the following fix(es):

 Fixed an issue with the bugged menu popup in the combat scene.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_200925
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update with the following fix(es):

 Fixed an issue with the "Resurrect" where a character would lose the ability to act after using it.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_180925
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update with the following fix(es):

 Fixed issues related to the non-unit AI freezes. (Such as Rock Fall, Rain of Arrows)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_170925
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update with the following fix(es):  

Fixed issues related to status effects that could cause the player to become stuck while enemies continued taking turns.

notes.title: Balance Patch 1.0_040925
notes.notes:
Based on your feedback, we’ve just rolled out a balance update with the following changes:


Abilities

Elusive (skeletons’ passive ability): Effect reduced from 50% → 30%.

Burst (dagger ability used by cutthroats): Damage reduced by 2 and it no longer applies a debuff.

Units

Regular enemies in the second act now have their Power reduced by 2.



Have fun on the battlefield! ⚔️

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_160825
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update with the following fix(es):


 Fixed issues related to the "Root" ability — it now works as intended.
 Fixed issues with combat menu text.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_140825
notes.notes:
We have just released an update with the following fix(es):

Fixed issues related to the "Devour" ability.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0_120825
notes.notes:
We have just released an update with the following fixes:

Fixed a bug where action bar was disabling certain abilities even when they were not on cooldown.

Fixed a rare bug where a power-up could not be picked up.

Fixed an issue where some characters would incorrectly appear with the same name as others.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0_110825
notes.notes:
We have just released an update with the following fixes:

Fixed an issue where some players could not select characters on the squad setup screen.

Corrected the tooltip text for the Scroll of Power, which was showing the wrong amount of Power.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0_050825
notes.notes:
We have just released an update with the following fixes:

Fixed a bug with the Necromancer where, in certain situations after a victory, the player could become stuck on the battle screen.

Fixed an issue that prevented one of the random events from loading properly for some players.

Fixed the animation for the ability "Choking Dust Cloud" not playing as intended.

notes.title: Valiant Tactics – Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



We’re thrilled to announce that Valiant Tactics will launch on August 4th, 2025!

After months of refining mechanics, polishing visuals and integrating your feedback from the playtests, we’re finally ready to bring the full experience to your hands.


[previewyoutube="JkjKyJs3c9M;full"][/previewyoutube]


🛡️ What awaits you at launch?



⚔️ Engage in Tactical Turn-Based Combat
Command your squad across dynamic battlefields, using positioning, abilities and careful planning to overcome every enemy force.



🧭 Make Meaningful Decisions
Choose between recruiting new characters, buying powerful weapons, or letting your squad rest and shape your journey through event choices that affect your campaign.



👑 Defeat the Usurper and Restore the Kingdom
Face the ultimate challenge as you battle the Usurper, conquer the final boss fight and reclaim the kingdom’s rightful peace.



👉 Wishlist Valiant Tactics now to be notified the moment it goes live!

💬 Join our Discord to discuss builds, share your victories and connect with fellow commanders.



Thank you for your support and see you on the battlefield,

The Valiant Tactics Team
